label: late copy phase, after re-input v/i or when outputting z/e/j
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>), almost entirely at recall_idx >= 3, and its rate rises toward the end of the sequence (to_go 0-1 carry 63% of mass). Within the copy phase it is token-modulated. The strongest driver is the previous input being v (rate 28%, 42% of mass; the top activations are nearly all on the step right after a copied v), followed by prev_tok i. It is also elevated when the output token is z, e or j (rate about 20% each). The predicate captures 75% of activation mass and 85% of top-quartile steps on dev, but precision is about 0.45. There is also a diffuse weak tail across many other late copy steps that no simple condition picks up. Does not fire at recall_idx 0-1 or on first occurrences of a token.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: v, i, j, s, t, 3; least: <DEL>, f, 0, r) and the token being output (most: z, j, e, b, t, 3; least: d, q, a, -); timing cues that raise it most: phase=2, recall_idx=4, recall_idx=5.
